SELECT * from (select t.je_head_id, t.je_number, t.period_name, t.je_status, t.je_date, t.currency, (select sum(nvl(gl.dr_amount, 0)) from gld_je_line gl where gl.je_head_id = t.je_head_id) je_amount, t.description, case when (select gl.je_trx from gld_je_line gl where gl.je_head_id = t.je_head_id and rownum=1) = 'PRE_FIN_INCOME_RECOGNITION' THEN '预' ELSE '业' end je_type, --凭证分类 t.gl_msg, t.gl_status, (select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb where scvb.CODE_ID = scb.CODE_ID and scb.code = 'GLD.GL_STATUS' and scvb.value = t.gl_status) as gl_status_n, t.voucher_id, t.voucher_number, t.je_creation_date, (select fc.ws_com_code from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = t.company_id) com_org_num,
( SELECT wm_concat(gv.JE_TRX_EDSCRIPTION) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT glt.description AS JE_TRX_EDSCRIPTION, gjl.JE_HEAD_ID FROM gld_je_line gjl, gld_je_trx glt WHERE gjl.JE_TRX = glt.je_trx ) gv WHERE gv.JE_HEAD_ID = t.JE_HEAD_ID GROUP BY gv.JE_HEAD_ID ) AS JE_TRX_DESCRIPTION
from gld_je_head t) v where 1=1 and nvl(v.je_status,'NEW')='CONFIRM'
and trunc(v.JE_DATE) >= trunc(to_date(#{dateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'))
and trunc(v.JE_DATE) <= trunc(to_date(#{dateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'))
AND v.je_amount >=#{amountFrom}
AND v.voucher_number LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{voucherNumber}),'%')
AND v.je_number LIKE CONCAT(concat('%',#{jeNumber}),'%')
AND v.gl_status =#{glStatus}
and v.period_name like concat(concat('%',#{periodName}),'%')
and v.je_status = #{jeStatus}
and v.description like concat(concat('%',#{description}),'%')
and v.je_head_id IN (SELECT l.je_head_id FROM gld_je_line l WHERE l.je_description like concat(concat('%',#{jeDescription}),'%'))
and v.je_head_id IN (SELECT l.je_head_id FROM gld_je_line l WHERE l.segment_3 like concat(concat('%',#{paymentNumber}),'%'))

SELECT temp.* FROM ( SELECT gjh.JE_HEAD_ID, gjh.JE_HD_TEMPLATE_ID, gjh.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, gjh.DOCUMENT_TYPE, gjh.BUSINESS_TYPE, gjh.COMPANY_ID, gjh.JE_NUMBER, gjh.JE_HEAD_STR, gjh.JE_DATE, gjh.PERIOD_NAME, gjh.CURRENCY, gjh.DESCRIPTION, gjh.JE_STATUS, gjh.JE_CREATED_BY, gjh.JE_CREATION_DATE, gjh.JE_CONFIRMED_BY, gjh.JE_CONFIRM_DATE, gjh.GL_STATUS, gjh.GL_MSG, gjh.OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER, gjh.CREATION_DATE, gjh.JE_CREATION_DATE as CREATED_DATE, gjh.REVERSE_FLAG, gjh.REVERSE_JE_HEAD_ID, gjh.OPERATE_ID, gjh.VOUCHER_NUMBER, gjh.VOUCHER_ID, gjh.TRIALED_BY, gjh.RETRIALED_BY, gjh.EXCHANGE_RATE, (select t.description from HLS_DOCUMENT_TYPE t WHERE T.document_category = 'GLD_JE_HEAD' AND t.business_type = gjh.business_type) business_type_n, ( SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM hls_document_status WHERE document_category = 'GLD_JE_HEAD' AND status_code = gjh.je_status ) AS JE_STATUS_DESCRIPTION, (select fc.company_full_name from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = gjh.company_id) company_name, (SELECT fc.currency_name FROM fnd_currency fc WHERE fc.currency_code = gjh.currency) currency_n, ( SELECT SUM(gjl.DR_AMOUNT) FROM gld_je_line gjl WHERE gjl.JE_HEAD_ID = gjh.JE_HEAD_ID ) AS DR_AMOUNT_TOTAL, ( SELECT SUM(gjl.CR_AMOUNT) FROM gld_je_line gjl WHERE gjl.JE_HEAD_ID = gjh.JE_HEAD_ID ) AS CR_AMOUNT_TOTAL, ( SELECT wm_concat(v.JE_TRX_EDSCRIPTION) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT glt.description AS JE_TRX_EDSCRIPTION, gjl.JE_HEAD_ID FROM gld_je_line gjl, gld_je_trx glt WHERE gjl.JE_TRX = glt.je_trx ) v WHERE v.JE_HEAD_ID = gjh.JE_HEAD_ID GROUP BY v.JE_HEAD_ID ) AS JE_TRX_DESCRIPTION, ( SELECT wm_concat(v.JE_TRX) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT gjl.JE_HEAD_ID,gjl.JE_TRX FROM gld_je_line gjl ) v WHERE v.JE_HEAD_ID = gjh.JE_HEAD_ID GROUP BY v.JE_HEAD_ID ) AS JE_TRX FROM gld_je_head gjh ) temp
1=1
AND temp.je_head_id = #{jeHeadId}
AND ( temp.DR_AMOUNT_TOTAL = #{amountValue} OR temp.CR_AMOUNT_TOTAL = #{amountValue} )
AND temp.description LIKE concat(concat('%',#{description}),'%')
AND temp.je_number LIKE concat(concat('%',#{jeNumber}),'%')
AND #{jeStatus} = temp.JE_STATUS
AND to_char(temp.JE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{dateFrom}
AND to_char(temp.JE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #{dateTo}
AND JE_TRX IN
#{item}
AND temp.JE_STATUS IN
#{item}
AND temp.PERIOD_NAME IN
#{item}
AND (CR_AMOUNT_TOTAL BETWEEN #{amountFrom} AND #{amountTo} OR CR_AMOUNT_TOTAL BETWEEN #{amountFrom} AND #{amountTo})
AND (CR_AMOUNT_TOTAL > #{amountFrom} OR CR_AMOUNT_TOTAL > #{amountFrom})
AND (CR_AMOUNT_TOTAL < #{amountFrom} OR CR_AMOUNT_TOTAL < #{amountFrom})
AND #{contractNumberFrom} <( SELECT min(conInfo.CONTRACT_NUMBER) FROM ( SELECT gjl.*, ( SELECT CONTRACT_NUMBER FROM con_contract WHERE contract_id = ( SELECT JE_SOURCE_ID FROM GLD_JE_TRX_DTL WHERE gjl.SOURCE_ID = JE_TRX_DTL_ID ) ) AS CONTRACT_NUMBER, gjtd.JE_SOURCE_ID FROM gld_je_line gjl, gld_je_trx_dtl gjtd WHERE gjtd.JE_SOURCE_DOC = 'CON_CONTRACT' AND gjl.SOURCE_ID = gjtd.JE_TRX_DTL_ID ) conInfo WHERE conInfo.JE_HEAD_ID = temp.JE_HEAD_ID )
AND #{contractNumberTo}>( SELECT max(conInfo.CONTRACT_NUMBER) FROM ( SELECT gjl.*, ( SELECT CONTRACT_NUMBER FROM con_contract WHERE contract_id = ( SELECT JE_SOURCE_ID FROM GLD_JE_TRX_DTL WHERE gjl.SOURCE_ID = JE_TRX_DTL_ID ) ) AS CONTRACT_NUMBER, gjtd.JE_SOURCE_ID FROM gld_je_line gjl, gld_je_trx_dtl gjtd WHERE gjtd.JE_SOURCE_DOC = 'CON_CONTRACT' AND gjl.SOURCE_ID = gjtd.JE_TRX_DTL_ID ) conInfo WHERE conInfo.JE_HEAD_ID = temp.JE_HEAD_ID )
order by creation_date desc

select distinct h.je_status from gld_je_line l, gld_je_trx_dtl d, GLD_JE_HEAD H d.je_trx_dtl_id = l.source_id and h.je_head_id = l.je_head_id and d.je_trx = 'CONTRACT_INCEPT' and d.je_source_doc = 'CON_CONTRACT' and d.je_trx_id = #{jeTrxId}

select v.* from ( select t.je_head_id, t.je_number, t.period_name, t.je_date, t.description, t.document_type, t.gl_status, t.company_id, t.trialed_by, t.retrialed_by, (SELECT s.description FROM sys_user s WHERE s.user_id = t.trialed_by) trialed_by_n, (SELECT s.description FROM sys_user s WHERE s.user_id = t.retrialed_by) retrialed_by_n, (select fc.company_full_name from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = t.company_id) company_name, (select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb where scvb.CODE_ID = scb.CODE_ID and scb.code = 'GLD.GL_STATUS' and scvb.value = t.gl_status) as gl_status_n, sum(l.dr_amount) as dr_amount, sum(l.cr_amount) as cr_amount, t.je_status, ( SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM hls_document_status WHERE document_category = 'GLD_JE_HEAD' AND status_code = t.je_status ) AS je_status_n from gld_je_head t left join gld_je_line l on t.je_head_id = l.je_head_id group by t.je_head_id, t.je_number, t.period_name, t.je_date, t.description, t.document_type, t.gl_status, t.je_status, t.TRIALED_BY, t.RETRIALED_BY, t.company_id) v
and v.je_number like concat(concat('%',#{jeNumber}),'%')
and v.trialed_by_n like concat(concat('%',#{trialedByN}),'%')
and v.retrialed_by_n like concat(concat('%',#{retrialedByN}),'%')
and v.period_name like concat(concat('%',#{periodName}),'%')
and v.description like concat(concat('%',#{description}),'%')
and trunc(v.je_date) >= trunc(#{jeDateFrom})
and trunc(v.je_date) <= trunc(#{jeDateTo})
and v.je_status = #{jeStatus}
and v.gl_status = #{glStatus}
and v.je_head_id IN (SELECT l.je_head_id FROM gld_je_line l WHERE l.je_description like concat(concat('%',#{jeDescription}),'%'))
and v.je_head_id IN ( (SELECT l.je_head_id FROM GLD_JE_TRX_DTL ld,gld_je_line l WHERE ld.JE_TRX_DTL_ID = l.source_id and l.source_type='JE_TRX_DTL' AND ld.je_source_doc = 'CON_CONTRACT' AND ld.je_source_id = (SELECT cc.contract_id FROM con_contract cc WHERE cc.contract_number LIKE concat(concat('%',#{paymentNumber}),'%') AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL')) )
and ((v.dr_amount = v.cr_amount and v.document_type != 'OFFBS') or v.document_type = 'OFFBS')
and 1 = 1 order by v.je_date desc
